name: bench-smola
title: files from GitHub repositories, the samples of smola/language-dataset (2019–2022), 261 languages
labels: a human for 1,107 files (gold); for 2,765, the dataset's vote, i.e. Linguist's own answer of 2019–2022 (silver)
sampling: all (every sample with a language label; one file per repository, ~20 per language, picked where Linguist named the language)
strengths: real files from 3,872 different repositories, under their real names
1,107 labels checked by a human, of which 167 correct Linguist's answer (tag `human-overrode-linguist`)
a different source from bench-linguist: only 3 files are Linguist samples
weaknesses: the silver labels (2,765 files) are Linguist's own answers: circular for the Linguist family (and Synid, built from it) — read the gold tier
every sample was picked because Linguist (via GitHub's language search and a Linguist scan) named its language: files Linguist finds hard are under-represented, even in the gold tier
one human annotator for nearly all gold labels; no agreement measure
175 samples whose label is `Unknown` (or contested) are not scored
